method: Loopback on a heavily shared host, disk outputs, private local relays, three rotating trials per tool/mode, per-file SHA256/name/size/empty-directory verification after equal recursive file and directory fsync. No physical LAN/WAN or mobile claim.
binaryNote: Folder cases use the final binary after copy-buffer reuse. Other cases use the preceding compression binary; their single-file path is unaffected by the folder-only change. Per-task hashes identify each tested executable.
